principle: Source post is indivisible. Each leave-family-out fold removes every source sharing the named channel, inferred merchant family, or conservative schedule-family tag. Overlapping folds are correlated diagnostics and must not be pooled. Family tags are deterministic lexical heuristics for partitioning only, not semantic labels or gold.
